text: {"features":[{"name":"Production depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates sustained responsibility for testing, maintaining, and launching production software beyond the role’s minimum bar.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only a minimal qualifying production record, typically around three years and a small number of services, with little sense of scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a modest production record, such as a few years across several services or longer tenure with limited service ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a solid mid-range background that clearly exceeds the minimum through multi-year work and credible exposure to several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production depth through sustained multi-year experience with repeated ownership across multiple launched services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the deepest production background, combining long tenure with broad repeated ownership of production services across testing, maintenance, and launch."}]},{"name":"Go fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter presents Go as a language of real depth for the candidate’s production engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only as one language among others, with no indication that it is central to the candidate’s work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Describes Go as a regular work language, but not as a primary tool or as the basis of meaningful systems ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a major or daily language for production work, but with limited detail beyond general use."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as the primary language for role-relevant back-end or automation systems with clear production responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows Go as the dominant implementation language and ties it to concrete architectural responsibility for production back-end or control systems."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"How strongly the letter shows relevant Python depth for automation, internal tooling, services, or AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only briefly or as incidental scripting without meaningful production context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes Python as a regular tool for services or internal tooling, but without much detail on depth or ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Python as a major part of production services, automation, or internal tooling with clear day-to-day ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as production-grade engineering for services, automation, or agents, with evidence that reliability matters and other engineers depend on or extend the work."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"How much relevant experience the letter shows with building and operating AI-enabled software in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no AI or model-related experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at AI interest or exposure, but gives no concrete shipped work or deployment context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions building AI or LLM features, but gives limited detail about production use or operating constraints."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes shipped AI functionality in production and acknowledges evaluation, reliability, or failure-mode management."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production AI experience that is explicitly tied to trustworthy behavior, evaluation, or safeguards relevant to security automation."}]},{"name":"Agent architecture","description":"How well the letter demonstrates hands-on design ownership of agentic systems relevant to the team’s responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic tooling or autonomous workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomous tasks only at a high level without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic workflows, but the system design or ownership is only partly clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes architecting agentic systems end to end, usually pairing agents with explicit back-end control mechanisms."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong design ownership of agentic systems with clear boundaries, permissions, auditability, or guardrails around autonomous behavior."}]},{"name":"Triage automation","description":"How directly the letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, handling, or triage workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automating security work, but gives no concrete example of having done it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Claims experience automating vulnerability handling or triage, but with little detail about what was automated."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage automation such as classification, deduplication, prioritization, or routing to owners."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability-handling automation as a major accomplishment with clear process design and explicit reduction of expert manual workload."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates practical experience performing security reviews or assessments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest through adjacent experience or credentials, but does not describe actual assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience with security assessments, threat modeling, or reviews, but gives only thin detail on scope or method."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment work using methods such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a systematic engineering practice that informs design, release, or remediation decisions."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How well the letter evidences strong use of data structures and algorithms in real engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of algorithmic thinking or data-structure choice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Asserts strong fundamentals, but provides no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one relevant example of improving a system through a better structure or algorithm choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links algorithmic skill to a performance-critical or otherwise demanding production problem with meaningful simplification or speedup."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic fluency feel central to the candidate’s engineering approach through a specific high-leverage example that shows real depth."}]},{"name":"Security validation","description":"How much the letter adds external, hands-on evidence of security capability beyond ordinary software work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no external evidence of hands-on security practice beyond general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes one modest external signal, such as a baseline certification or casual capture-the-flag participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear ongoing extra-professional security engagement through regular capture-the-flag practice, a solid certification, or similar evidence."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Includes a strong external signal such as OSCP or consistently strong capture-the-flag performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows multiple strong external signals that materially deepen security credibility, such as OSCP plus high-level capture-the-flag results."}]},{"name":"Independent initiative","description":"How much the letter shows self-directed technical building or maintainership outside assigned job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no self-directed technical work outside core job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or occasional patching, but with limited evidence of sustained ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows steady self-directed building through a maintained utility, repeated contributions, or a modest side project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial side project or active open-source maintenance that demonstrates real ownership and follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents demanding self-directed systems work or meaningful maintainership with users, contributors, releases, or complex distributed design."}]},{"name":"Role understanding","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates a concrete grasp of this team’s mandate to scale security through tooling, automation, and lifecycle integration.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only generic interest in software or security without connecting to this team’s actual work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Recognizes the role as security or infrastructure work, but stays broad about what the team specifically does."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects to one core part of the job, such as secure development, vulnerability response, or automation, but not the full shape of the mandate."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear understanding of the mission to scale security through tooling, lifecycle integration, or vulnerability handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Frames the role in terms of leverage, proactive developer assistance, and automation of expert security work at large scale."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How specific and compelling the candidate’s stated reasons are for wanting this exact role rather than a generic software position.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses motivation in generic terms that could apply to many software jobs."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives a plausible reason for applying, but in broad or boilerplate language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Offers at least one specific reason tied to security, platform work, or Google’s scale."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects multiple past experiences or values to this role in a way that feels deliberate and credible."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a memorable, deeply role-specific motivation that makes the application feel purposeful rather than opportunistic."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"How strongly the letter shows a service mindset toward enabling other engineers through low-friction, trustworthy tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little sense of serving downstream engineers or reducing friction for other people."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at collaboration or platform work, but does not explain how users of the tooling are supported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in helping engineers or reducing toil, but the service mindset is not strongly developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes making secure behavior easier, reducing friction, or building tools that other engineers can trust."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Strongly conveys a platform-service mentality in which downstream adoption, trust, and workflow fit are treated as core design concerns."}]},{"name":"Impact evidence","description":"How consistently the letter backs its claims with concrete examples, technical specifics, and observable outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims and adjectives without supporting evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names relevant experiences, but gives few concrete examples or outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes some specific examples, though the significance or result is only partly clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly supports claims with concrete projects, responsibilities, or operational improvements."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently ties qualifications to specific evidence with clear outcomes, leverage, or problem-solution-result framing."}]},{"name":"Structural coherence","description":"How effectively the letter organizes its content into a clear, cumulative argument for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed or list-like, making the case hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure, but develops points unevenly, repetitively, or with weak transitions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is coherent and readable, though it mostly strings qualifications together rather than building a strong arc."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is well organized, with each paragraph advancing a distinct part of the candidacy."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is highly cohesive and persuasive, using structure to build a cumulative case for fit."}]},{"name":"Mechanical accuracy","description":"How polished the sentence-level mechanics are, especially spelling, grammar, and typo control.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling or typographical mistakes that noticeably distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible errors that weaken polish even though meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a few slips, but still reads as generally careful."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is nearly error-free, with at most isolated minor issues."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is cleanly edited and professionally polished, with no meaningful mechanical mistakes."}]}]}
